channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Canada, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Video Pool: Media Art + Technology Residency (MATR) 2027
    https://videopool.org/media-arts-technology-residency-2027-call-for-applications/
    Video Pool Media Arts Centre · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · CAD 2,250 artist fee, covering both the residency period and the subsequent Poolside Gallery exhibition. Residents also get full access to VP's equipment, facilities and technical resources; the Poolside Gallery itself is equipped with two projectors and four speakers. Applicants must be VP members, so a membership is purchased separately, but there is no separate application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residencies - week of 08 Jun 2026
item.description:
• City of Ottawa: Vanier Artist-in-Residence 2027 (RFQ)
    https://ottawa.ca/en/arts-heritage-and-events/funding-calls-and-opportunities/calls-and-opportunities-culture/calls-and-opportunities-public-art-program/request-qualifications-vanier-artist-residence/opportunity
    City of Ottawa Public Art Program · deadline Closed 26 Jun 2026 · CAD 40,000 plus HST if applicable for the Artist-in-Residence (inclusive of all residency costs), with an additional CAD 40,000 to 70,000 available afterward to create a final legacy public artwork. No application fee.
  • SAT x LAB7: Performing Arts and Technology Research-Creation Residency 2026 (Montreal)
    https://sat.qc.ca/en/calls/performing-arts-and-technology-research-creation-residencies-sat-x-lab7
    Societe des arts technologiques (SAT) in partnership with LAB7 / 7 Fingers (Les 7 Doigts) · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · CAD 10,000 grant per selected project, plus roughly two weeks (about 10 days) of studio workspace at the 7 Fingers Creation Centre and personalised coaching from the SAT and LAB7 teams. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residencies - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Barbara Spohr Memorial Award for Photography 2027
    https://www.banffcentre.ca/programs/barbara-spohr-memorial-award-photography
    Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity · deadline Closed 17 Jun 2026 · 100 percent scholarship covering tuition, single bedroom accommodation and meal plan, plus a travel bursary (regional maximums apply) and a 1,000 CAD material-support cheque issued directly to the awardee. CAD 65 application fee (CAD 35 for applicants who identify as Indigenous).
  • Michele Larose - Osler Library Artist-in-Residence 2026-2027
    https://www.mcgill.ca/libraries/locations/osler/awards/artist-residence
    Osler Library of the History of Medicine, McGill University (funded by Dr. Michele Larose) · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · $6,000 CAD (taxes may be deducted); paid in two parts (half at the beginning of the residency, half on completion). Covers travel, materials, and related expenses. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 25 May 2026
item.description:
• DARC Indigenous Residency 2026
    https://digitalartsresourcecentre.ca/indigenous-residency/
    Digital Arts Resource Centre (DARC), with The Hnatyshyn Foundation · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · CAD $2,500 artist fee, plus $520 for an artist talk, $1,504 for a chosen artistic/Indigenous advisor (16 hrs), up to $4,000 in DARC equipment/facility waivers, transit/parking honorarium for local artists, and for non-local artists up to $1,500 housing subsidy and $1,750 travel. Plus an Asinabka festival pass and one year of DARC membership/workshops. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 11 May 2026
item.description:
• Banff Centre: Visual Arts Thematic Residency - Future Figurations (2027)
    https://www.banffcentre.ca/programs/visual-arts/visual-arts-thematic-future-figurations-residency
    Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity · deadline Closed 03 Jun 2026 · Paid program. Total before scholarships: CAD $9,484.55 per person. With the Banff Centre Arts Scholarship (100% tuition + 25% accommodation/meals): CAD $4,384.73 per person. Canadian Indigenous Scholarship: 100% tuition + accommodation + meals (no out-of-pocket). Application fee: CAD $65 (individuals/groups), CAD $35 for Indigenous applicants. No artist stipend.
